mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND project_id = #{projectId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (review_content, rating, user_id, project_id) VALUES (#{reviewContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rating}, #{userId}, #{projectId})
mapper.select: SELECT v.review_id, p.project_name, r.reward_name, u.user_name, v.rating, v.review_content, v.review_at FROM review v JOIN funding f ON f.user_id = v.user_id AND f.project_id = v.project_id JOIN reward r ON r.reward_id = f.reward_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = v.project_id JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = v.user_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.project_id = #{projectId}
